related_questions.question: What are the chances of getting cancer with the BRCA mutation?
related_questions.snippet: Having a BRCA mutation means you have a likelihood of 45% to 85% for developing breast cancer in your lifetime, along with a 10% to 46% chance of ovarian cancer. The probability of breast cancer among the general population is about 12%. Ovarian cancer is rarer, affecting less than 1% of the general U.S. population.
